 Australian Shares Buy the Madman!
 David Llewellyn-Smith Tuesday 20 October 2026 Add MacroBusiness as a preferred source Advertisement TME on the market setup. 
 The shock 
 Friday’s explosion in VIX and VVIX was nothing short of extreme. The price action had all the hallmarks of forced deleveraging, with risk managers hitting the brakes and traders scrambling for tail protection at virtually any price. This was panic hedging, not ordinary volatility buying.
